rule:
for each muscle whose StatPearls chapter matched by its OWN name
(atlas/explain/index.json entries without "via"), every sentence of the
chapter that contains "origin"/"originat" (origin sentences) or "insert"
(insertion sentences). A bone counts as named in a sentence when any of its
synonyms below appears (word match). The rule is mechanical and stated:
  origin agrees    = an inferred origin bone is named in an origin sentence
  insertion agrees = an inferred insertion bone is named in an insertion sentence
  (lenient: a sentence naming both ends counts for both). STRICT scores use only
  the clause from "origin"/"originat" up to "insert" (and from "insert" up to
  "origin"), so the other end's bones in the same sentence do not count.
